1. Introduction
This document constitutes MODULE 3.2.S — DRUG SUBSTANCE of the Common Technical Document (CTD) format as specified in ICH M4 guidelines for the biologics license application (BLA) of mRNA-1273 (Spikevax) submitted by Moderna, Inc. to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA). The submission follows the eCTD format as required by 21 CFR Part 314 and FDA guidance on eCTD submissions.
2. General Information
INN (Proposed): elasomeran
Molecular Formula: mRNA (sequence proprietary)
Chemical Class: Messenger RNA (mRNA), lipid nanoparticle formulated
Route of Administration: Intramuscular injection
3. Manufacture
mRNA-1273 drug substance is manufactured at Moderna, Inc.'s facility in Norwood, MA using in vitro transcription (IVT) technology. The manufacturing process involves DNA template preparation, IVT reaction, mRNA purification via tangential flow filtration and chromatography, and final formulation. The manufacturing process is controlled to ensure consistent quality.
